stages.why: Reject missing, legacy, or non-concrete nested SuperNPU manifests before compilation.
Require the pinned v0.58 Linx-TileOP-API and LLVM to produce a fresh Linx ELF.
Require an explicit QEMU terminal oracle before model promotion.
Require a fresh LinxCoreModel build and known-good smoke ELF.
Run only QEMU-passing ELFs in LinxCoreModel.
Compare QEMU and model evidence without transferring a pass between implementations.
Publish bounded failure packets for the first failing owner.
Record whether reusable workflow guidance changed.
